title: Lunch
subtitle: See when your child will have lunch and what is being served.
noLinkedChildren: Once a child is linked to your account, you will see the school's meal plan here.
empty: The meal plan is currently not enabled for your school.
emptyThisWeekTitle: No meal plan has been entered for this week yet
emptyNextWeekTitle: No meal plan has been entered for next week yet
emptyWeek: Once the after-school care team enters a plan, you will see it here.
editRegularDaysHint: Choose the days when {name} will have lunch.
finishEdit: Save or cancel before choosing another child or week.
cancelledByAbsence: Cancelled because your child is absent
closedDay: The OGS is closed on this day
participationDeadlines: Each day shows until when you can change it.
participationSicknessDeadline: A confirmed sick note or absence up to a day's deadline cancels your child's lunch. After that, the meal stays ordered.
participationSicknessDay: A confirmed sick note or absence up to the day of the meal cancels your child's lunch.
scheduleLocked: Registration for the school year has closed. Only the school can change the regular days now.
cancelWeekText: {name} will be cancelled on every day of this week that you can still change.
cancelWeekLocked: These days were already ordered and stay registered: {days}.
registerWeekLocked: The registration deadline for these days has passed; they stay unregistered: {days}.
participationCutoffLead: You can change the registration until {time} {days, plural, one {on the working day before the meal} other {# working days before the meal}}.
participationSicknessLead: A confirmed sick note by {time} {days, plural, one {on the working day before the meal} other {# working days before the meal}} cancels lunch. After that, the registration remains unchanged.
